title: Visible PvP button does not load the PvP domain on first use

environment.browser: Safari target; local regression uses Playwright Chromium mobile viewport

reproduction: Open KELO WORLD from a cold page load where the PvP domain has not been loaded yet.
Observe that the button asks KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp').
On the broken build, ensure('pvp') resolves after loading only combat foundations, while enterPvPWorld is still absent.
The UI then falls through to the 'PvP todavía cargando' path instead of entering the PvP world.
expected: The first visible PVP tap loads the complete PvP first-use domain, installs enterPvPWorld, enters mode=pvp and enables combat without putting the full PvP domain into initial boot.
actual: The pre-fix module loader treated combat foundations as sufficient for the pvp feature and did not load pvp-world.js or pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js, so the visible button could finish loading without an enterPvPWorld function.
evidence: src/ui/luxe-shell.js visible button handler calls KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') then checks window.enterPvPWorld.
Pre-fix src/core/module-loader.js special-cased pvp by calling only KeloRuntimeBootstrap.ensure().
src/systems/pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js requires an existing KeloPvPWorld and installs the enterPvPWorld lazy facade.
owner_hint: KeloModuleLoader first-use lifecycle delegating gameplay ownership to KeloPvPWorld

research.summary: The button and gameplay owner were already correct. The gap was the feature lifecycle contract: ensure('pvp') loaded only shared combat foundations, not the PvP domain that defines enterPvPWorld. The candidate registers PvP as a real first-use feature pack and keeps KeloPvPWorld as gameplay owner.

known_facts.statement: The visible Luxe PVP button calls KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') when loader.needs('pvp') is true, then calls enterPvPWorld only if that function exists.
Before the candidate fix, KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') returned KeloRuntimeBootstrap.ensure() and did not load the PvP domain scripts.
pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js does not create KeloPvPWorld; it requires KeloPvPWorld to already exist and then publishes enterPvPWorld.

hypotheses.theory: The first-use feature contract is incomplete: combat foundations are being mistaken for a fully loaded PvP domain.
hypotheses.why: The visible button waits on ensure('pvp'), while the pre-fix ensure implementation never loads the files that define KeloPvPWorld/enterPvPWorld.
hypotheses.test_next: Run the visible-button Playwright regression from a cold page load and require KELO_MODULE_LOADER.isReady('pvp'), mode=pvp and combatEnabled=true.

ruled_out.theory: The visible button has no PvP handler.
ruled_out.reason: The handler exists and correctly requests the pvp feature before calling enterPvPWorld.

unknowns.question: Does the candidate pass the complete cold-load visible-button flow under the repository Playwright gate?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The defect is player-facing; code inspection alone cannot promote it to VERIFIED.

external_references.title: Playwright auto-waiting
external_references.lesson: Use a real locator.click on the visible PvP button so the regression validates visibility, stability, event reception and enabled state instead of bypassing UI with page.evaluate.

attempt_history.goal: Reconnect the visible PvP first-use path without moving the full PvP domain into initial boot.

change.summary: Register PvP as a first-use feature pack, make ensure('pvp') load foundations then the PvP domain, require the domain-ready facade for isReady/needs, and change regression coverage to tap the visible PVP button.

validation.method: Playwright visible-button first-use test plus foundation/docs audits.

attempt_history.conclusion: A concrete candidate exists; verification is still pending and must not be represented as complete until the workflow passes.
attempt_history.do_not_repeat_without: If the candidate fails, use the workflow trace/error to choose the next change instead of adding another loader or bypassing the visible button.

next_best_actions.action: Run the PvP First-Use Regression workflow on the pull request and inspect any failing Playwright step before changing code again.
next_best_actions.reason: It exercises the original player path from a cold load and distinguishes lifecycle failure from gameplay failure.
next_best_actions.expected_signal: The visible button loads the pvp feature, KeloPvPWorld enters mode=pvp, combatEnabled becomes true, and the existing dodge assertions pass.
next_best_actions.stop_condition: If the visible-button test fails, keep FIXED_PENDING_VERIFY and use the exact failing milestone; do not merge as verified.

fix.summary: PvP now has an explicit first-use pack and readiness means the PvP domain/facade is installed, not merely that shared combat foundations exist.

verification.method: GitHub Actions Playwright cold-load visible-button regression in a mobile viewport, followed by existing dodge assertions and foundation/docs audits.

notes: This bug is distinct from BrowserStack capacity: the candidate can be validated first with the repository's local Playwright mobile gate, while real-iPhone BrowserStack remains a stronger external acceptance step when capacity is available.
Do not mark VERIFIED solely from code inspection or a direct page.evaluate call to enterPvPWorld.
